# Language & Humanities

> An educational resource exploring language, literature, cognitive psychology, and humanities topics with guides on writing styles, literary forms, and learning theory.

Language & Humanities provides accessible guides to literary analysis, discourse types, poetry forms, and cognitive concepts. The site covers classical literature references (Shakespeare, Petrarch), linguistic phenomena, and educational theory for students and learners.

## Key Topics

- Literary Analysis
- Cognitive Psychology
- Knowledge Acquisition
- Learning Theory
- Discourse Types
- Poetry & Sonnets
- William Shakespeare
- Language & Etymology
- Petrarch
- Schema Formation
- Memory Encoding
- Idioms & Metaphor
- Queen Elizabeth I
- Information Processing
- Travel Fiction

## Literary Analysis & Poetry

- [What Is an Elizabethan Sonnet? (with picture)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-is-an-elizabethan-sonnet.htm): Elizabethan sonnet guide featuring Shakespeare, Petrarch, and poetry structure
- [What Is Travel Fiction? (with picture)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-is-travel-fiction.htm): Travel fiction genre analysis with Homer's Odyssey and literary examples
- [What Is an Achilles' Heel? (with picture)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-is-an-achilles-heel.htm): Idiom definition of Achilles' heel rooted in Greek mythology and metaphor

## Language & Linguistics

- [What Are the Different Types of Discourse? (with picture)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-are-the-different-types-of-discourse.htm): Overview of discourse types, writing styles, and rhetorical communication methods
- [What is the Royal We? (with pictures)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-is-the-royal-we.htm): Royal we pronoun guide featuring Queen Victoria, Elizabeth I, and linguistic history
- [What does It Mean When Someone Says They are Going to "Hit the Head"?](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-does-it-mean-when-someone-says-they-are-going-to-hit-the-head.htm): Naval slang etymology and military jargon origins from Navy terminology

## Cognitive Psychology & Learning

- [What Is Knowledge Acquisition? (with picture)](https://www.languagehumanities.org/what-is-knowledge-acquisition.htm): Guide to knowledge acquisition, cognitive psychology, and learning theory

- [Contact us](https://www.languagehumanities.org/contact.htm): Contact page for Language & Humanities in San Francisco, CA
